modelPosture.note: Model node is OPTIONAL and confined to interpretation/drafting. All control-plane steps are deterministic.

trustBoundary.name: DETERMINISTIC_CONTROL_PLANE_VS_OPTIONAL_MODEL_SANDBOX
trustBoundary.description: The model (if enabled) receives ONLY the question and the already-selected, already-filtered, already-cited source snippets. It never sees the permission table, the full corpus, the action tools, or the audit writer.
modelMay: draft prose strictly from supplied citations

nodes.name: PermissionResolve
nodes.desc: Load permission table FRESH each run; resolve principal; unknown user -> least privilege. Lab module access.js.

nodes.name: ScopeBeforeSearch
nodes.desc: Filter corpus by level+topic BEFORE retrieval. Restricted items never enter the searchable set. Lab module access.scopeCorpus.

nodes.name: DeterministicRetrieval
nodes.desc: tf-idf-style keyword scoring over the permitted slice only, with score breakdown. Lab module retrieve.js.

nodes.name: SafetySanitise
nodes.desc: Treat all document/chat text as DATA: detect+neutralise injected instructions, mask NIK/phone. Lab module safety.js.

nodes.name: ConflictResolution
nodes.desc: Group by claim key, flag differing values, pick newest / explicit superseding source, keep both cited. Lab module answer.detectConflicts.

nodes.name: OptionalModelDraft
nodes.desc: OPTIONAL: draft prose from supplied citations ONLY. Disabled and fail-closed until Gates 1-6 pass. Never connected to tools.

nodes.name: AnswerCompose
nodes.desc: Attach full citations, conflict flags, neutral owner route or refusal, notices, disclosure. Lab module answer.buildAnswer.

nodes.name: HumanApprovalGate
nodes.desc: Read-only brain: zero action execution. Any action requires a named human approval via approve.js on the risk path.

nodes.name: AuditAppend
nodes.desc: Append-only log of question, sources retrieved, answer returned, decisions, refusals, injections, masking. Lab module audit.js.

criticalEdgesNeverAllowed: N7 -> N9 (model must never reach the approval/action gate)
N7 -> N10 (model must never write the audit log)
N1 -> N4 (search must never precede authorisation)
N4 -> N9 (retrieval must never execute an action)

designTradeoffs.choice: Deterministic control plane over a model-driven agent
designTradeoffs.why: Guide §10 evaluators responsible-AI practice, not production engineering; §6 caps the ethics score at 5/10 for leaks or unapproved actions. Determinism makes the safety properties provable and testable offline.

designTradeoffs.choice: Same neutral answer for restricted and non-existent topics
designTradeoffs.why: Official Uji 1 explicitly forbids confirming that restricted content exists. Costs a little helpfulness, prevents a critical failure.
designTradeoffs.enforcedBy: agent/output-guard.js (REFUSAL_BRANCH) + agent/safety.js UNKNOWN_ANSWER template; verified by selftest-guard G-T03/G-T05

designTradeoffs.why: Official Uji 2 requires Rp750.000 AND both sources AND the SOP marked stale; hiding the loser would fail the test.
Preserves the accountable architecture; a model can never grant itself access or execute an action.
§3 requires the next answer to follow an access change; caching would violate it.

deterministicOutputGuard.cli: node agent/run.js selftest-guard  |  node agent/run.js guard-demo "<question>" --user=<id>
deterministicOutputGuard.ruleRefusalBranch: If the upstream control plane returned no permitted source, ANY model draft is discarded and the single shared UNKNOWN_ANSWER template is emitted. The model never owns the refusal text, so a restricted topic and a non-existent topic are byte-identical (official Uji 1: PERSIS SAMA).
deterministicOutputGuard.ruleAnswerBranch: A model draft may be used only if every figure it mentions already exists in the authorised citations it was given. Otherwise the draft is rejected and the deterministic cited answer is used.
deterministicOutputGuard.empiricalBasis: Finding F-01 in traces/native-model-execution-2026-11-04.json: two REAL model refusals for a restricted and a non-existent topic differed in wording under identical upstream state. Guarded, they become byte-identical.
deterministicOutputGuard.note: Guards the optional model node without changing the deterministic control plane. Node and edge counts are unchanged (10 nodes, 11 edges).
